named_subject: a twin-bell alarm clock with two hands and two small feet, sitting on a shelf
action: The clock turns away so its face narrows to a tall oval, holds there, then turns back to face front at full width.
identity_gap: The animated clock uses the same open circle, two arc bells, two straight hands with a center dot and two short angled feet as the doodle, so it reads as the same drawing.
notes: The turn is shown only as the circle squeezing into an oval and the hand doing the turning in the film is absent, and the change from frame 2 to 3 and from 11 to 12 happens in one step rather than across several frames. The change that would help most is spreading the turn-away and turn-back over more in-between frames so the width changes gradually.
